variants.title: PFG-NMR self-diffusion: water near 5 C (illustrative D)
variants.sample: Water near 5 C, D about 1.3e-9 m^2/s (unsourced / illustrative)
variants.note: Colder water diffuses more slowly than at 25 C; the value is quoted from memory and unsourced.

source.title: E. O. Stejskal and J. E. Tanner, J. Chem. Phys. 42, 288 (1965)

variants.title: PFG-NMR self-diffusion: a glycerol-water mixture (illustrative D)
variants.sample: Glycerol-water mixture, D about 2e-10 m^2/s (unsourced / illustrative)
variants.note: A viscous mixture diffuses ten times slower than water, so a much larger gradient is needed to attenuate the echo.

source.title: E. O. Stejskal and J. E. Tanner, J. Chem. Phys. 42, 288 (1965)
